source.title: Quantifying the Influence of the Pool Cover on the Water Evaporation Rate in Indoor Swimming Halls
source.org_or_authors: Smedegard, Stene, Georges; 19th IBPSA Conference, Brisbane (NTNU)

rows.note: Printed unit of m_evap is kg/s; the unit of the coefficient is not printed in the equation. Paper says original experiments involved only forced convection, that the equation is commonly applied at air speeds as low as 0 m/s, and that Smith et al. found it underpredicted occupied and overpredicted unoccupied pools. Indoor pool basis, not outdoors.
